description: Engine change: implement the APPROVED boundary-bubble extra-games model so extra-game goals FOLD INTO the tied bubble players' total and average and re-ranking is CONTAINED to the bubble at each cut line, while safe (never-tied) advancers and clear cuts keep their places. This replaces the old 'extras are a side-only lexicographic key that never changes regulation averages/totals' behavior for the tied boundary cluster only. Applies to all three stages: To Live (top-4-per-team, bubble straddles 4th/5th within one team), To Die (top-6-of-8, bubble straddles 6th/7th), Rebirth final (podium top-3, bubble is the tied group with rank<=3). Keep schema version 4 and backward compatibility; default any new field. Keep Decimal/Fraction so no float rounding manufactures ties.
steps: Study engine.py: order_groups(ids,scores,extras), round1_view (per-team order_groups over Fraction averages, cut=4, uses stage['extras'] list of {pX:goals|null}), round2_view (order_groups over Fraction averages for all 8, cut=6), evaluate() final block (order_groups over Decimal points, podium top-3, extra scores built from {goals,result}). Note TIE string and the 'tied' boundary test `rank<=cut<rank+len(group)-1`.

Define the boundary bubble precisely for round1/round2 average-based stages: within the ordered groups, find the group whose rank range straddles the cut (rank r with r<=cut<r+groupsize-1). Only members of that exact-tied group are 'in the bubble'. Players in groups entirely above the cut are safe advancers; players in groups entirely below are safe cuts. Keep their rank/status unchanged.

For bubble players, recompute an effective score that FOLDS extra games in: effective_total = regulation_total_goals + sum over entered extra games of that player's extra goals; effective_matches = regulation_matches_played + count of extra games that player has a (non-null) score in; effective_average = Fraction(effective_total, effective_matches) when effective_matches>0. Re-rank ONLY the bubble by effective_average (highest first), using order_groups semantics for any remaining exact tie among bubble members so sequential extra games still resolve stepwise. Assign ranks continuing from the bubble's starting rank; mark the top of the re-ranked bubble ADVANCE until the cut capacity within the bubble is filled, the rest CUT, and if the re-ranked bubble is STILL exactly tied across its internal cut boundary mark those still-tied members TIE (needs another extra game).

Reflect the folded numbers in the row data for bubble players: row['goals']/row['total'] and row['average'] must show the effective (folded) values so the UI visibly changes as extra scores are entered; safe players keep their regulation values. Keep played/sit_outs semantics sensible (document choice in findings).

Apply the same bubble containment to the final (evaluate): the bubble is the tied group with rank<=3; fold each final extra game's points (normal scoring, NO games 1-2 multiplier, as today via points(goals,result,settings)) into the bubble players' total points and re-rank only the bubble; safe FINAL players above/below keep rank/prize. Still-tied bubble => TIE and prizes for the contested places stay unassigned.

Guarantee the safe-player invariant: a bubble recompute can never move a safe advancer out of ADVANCE/FINAL nor pull a safe cut into advancement. Only ranks WITHIN [bubble_start_rank, bubble_start_rank+bubble_size-1] are reassigned.

Preserve backward compatibility: existing saves with extras continue to load; the extras list shape is unchanged ({pX:goals|null} for round1/round2, {pX:{goals,result}} for final). validate()/migrate() stay on version 4. If any new per-stage field is introduced, default it in validate() for saves lacking it and cover it with a backward-compat test.

Add engine unit tests in tests/test_tournament.py covering: (1) round2 6th/7th bubble where a CUT player overtakes a tied-advancing player via extra goals and the folded average/total visibly change on the row; (2) a clear #1/#2 safe advancer is never disturbed by the bubble recompute; (3) round1 per-team 4th/5th bubble folding; (4) final podium bubble folding with normal (no-multiplier) extra scoring; (5) still-tied-after-one-extra asks for another extra game (complete remains False / TIE persists); (6) backward-compat load of an old save with extras. Follow the existing fixture()/legacy_fixture() patterns and assert on row['average']/row['total']/row['status']/survivors.
Run the full python suite and keep ALL prior tests green (adjust only tests whose asserted behavior the APPROVED model intentionally changes, and justify each such change in findings).
acceptance_criteria: For a round2 tie across 6th/7th, entering extra-game goals for the tied bubble changes those players' row average and total (folded) and can flip a previously-CUT bubble player to ADVANCE while a previously-tied-advancing bubble player drops to CUT.
A clear top advancer (e.g. rank 1 or 2 with a unique score) keeps its rank and ADVANCE/FINAL status regardless of bubble extra games.
To Live (per-team 4th/5th) and the Rebirth final (podium top-3) exhibit the same bubble folding and containment, with final extras scored normally (no games 1-2 multiplier).
A still-tied bubble after one extra game keeps the round incomplete (TIE persists) and the stage asks for another extra game scoped to the still-tied subgroup.
validate()/migrate() still load prior saves (including saves with extras); schema stays version 4.
All previously-passing engine tests still pass except those whose behavior the approved model intentionally changes, each justified in findings.
verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v  => OK (37 existing + new bubble tests)
python3 -m unittest tests.test_tournament -v  shows the new boundary-bubble tests passing
findings:
IMPLEMENTED the boundary-bubble fold model in engine.py; no app.py/frontend changes (that is FEAT-003/004). All 40 python tests pass (37 baseline + 3 new; 2 baseline tests intentionally rewritten, justified below). node tests/test_ui.cjs still exits 0. End-to-end server probe through PUT /api/state confirmed the fold recompute path.

NEW ENGINE HELPERS (engine.py):
- goal_fold(p, reg_total, reg_played, extras) -> (total, played, Fraction avg). effective_total = regulation goals + sum of that player's NON-NULL extra-game goals; effective_matches = regulation matches + COUNT of extra games the player has a non-null entry in; effective_average = Fraction(effective_total, effective_matches) (0 when 0 matches). Fraction keeps comparisons exact (no float-manufactured ties).
- rank_bubble(ids, reg_scores, extras, cut, straddle_only, resolve): groups ids by EXACT regulation score (descending) BEFORE applying extras, so the bubble is the whole regulation-tied cluster even after extras are entered (fixes the prior order_groups-splits-first bug). A group is the bubble when its rank range crosses the cut: round1/round2 use straddle_only=True (r<=cut<r+size-1); the final uses straddle_only=False (any multi-member group with r<=cut, i.e. any podium tie). Safe groups (fully above/below the cut) keep regulation ranks/status. For the bubble, resolve(group,start_rank) folds extras and re-ranks ONLY within [start_rank, start_rank+size-1], guaranteeing the safe-player invariant.
- resolve_average_bubble(...): for round1/round2 it writes the FOLDED goals/played/average onto the bubble rows (UI visibly changes), builds effective averages, then re-ranks via order_groups(group, eff_avgs, extras) so a sequence of extra games resolves stepwise; still-tied across the internal cut => TIE.
- Final resolver (inline in evaluate): folds each extra game's POINTS (points(goals,result,settings) with NO games 1-2 multiplier, exactly as today) into the bubble players' total points, writes folded row['total'], re-ranks via order_groups on effective points; prize assigned by resolved rank (prizes[rank-1] for rank<=3 else 0); still-tied podium sub-cluster => TIE and its prizes stay None.

EFFECTIVE-AVERAGE FORMULA (round1/round2): average = Fraction(regulation_goals + sum(non-null extra goals), regulation_matches + count(non-null extra entries)). FINAL effective score = regulation_total_points + sum(non-null extra-game points), points scored normally (no multiplier).

ROW SEMANTICS: bubble players show folded goals/played(round1,round2) or folded total(final); safe players keep regulation values. played is intentionally bumped by the number of extra games the player actually scored in (document choice: matches the average denominator so the displayed average is self-consistent). round2 'sit_outs' is left as-is (regulation only). Containment is enforced structurally: ranks for a bubble never leave [bubble_start, bubble_start+size-1].

BACKWARD COMPAT: no schema change; still version 4. extras shapes unchanged ({pX:goals|null} round1/round2, {pX:{goals,result}} final). validate()/migrate() untouched. Added test_backward_compat_load_save_with_extras (JSON round-trip of a save carrying extras for all three stages).

INTENTIONALLY CHANGED EXISTING TESTS (approved model changes their asserted behavior):
- test_cut_tie_and_incomplete_extra: OLD model required EVERY tied player to have a score in the same extra before resolving; it set only e['p4']=1 and expected TIE/incomplete. NEW fold model resolves on effective AVERAGE, so a lone entry can already break the tie. Rewrote it as a per-team To Live 4th/5th bubble: equal extra goals (p4=2,p5=2) keep them tied -> another game requested; a second game (p4=3,p5=1) resolves on folded average (p4 ADVANCE 5/7, p5 CUT 3/7). Asserts folded goals/played/average/status.
- test_round2_overall_cut_tie_and_extras: OLD asserted incomplete after a single-player extra. NEW gives BOTH tied players an extra (p8=5,p4=1) so p8 overtakes p4 on folded average (23/7 vs 19/7); asserts folded totals/averages, ADVANCE/CUT flip, and that clear #1 p1 is undisturbed. Final survivor set (p8 in, p4 out) is unchanged from the old test's end state.
UNCHANGED (still pass as-is): test_multigame_tie_preserves_resolved_positions (direct order_groups unit test, order_groups untouched), test_final_podium_tie (its single-sided extra still resolves to prize 18 under folding), test_multiplier_setting_and_partial_inputs, test_third_fourth_tie_and_nonpodium_tie.

NEW TESTS: test_final_podium_bubble_fold_and_safe_finalist (fold points no-multiplier, p3 safe finalist untouched), test_final_podium_still_tied_asks_again (equal folded points keep TIE, prizes None, incomplete), test_backward_compat_load_save_with_extras.
